query:
SELECT cs.periodoCustoId, pc.mes, cs.grupoNome, SUM(cs.totalGeral) as total 
FROM custo_setor cs 
INNER JOIN periodo_custo pc ON cs.periodoCustoId = pc.id
WHERE pc.mes IN (2,3) AND pc.ano = 2026 
GROUP BY cs.periodoCustoId, pc.mes, cs.grupoNome 
ORDER BY pc.mes, total DESC;
